_comment: Rule sets for size_report.py option: features each one removes from a finished pack, to measure what it would save. A rule matches by layer and optionally kind / kind_not, geometry (point, line, polygon), max_area_px (polygons smaller than this many pixels of a 256-px tile), zooms or only_max_zoom; drop_layer removes the whole layer; simplify_px simplifies matching lines and polygons with this tolerance in pixels of a 256-px tile instead of removing them.

poi_drop.what_is_lost: street furniture, trees, crossings, railway switches and signals, turning circles, parking spaces (build_config.json poi_drop_kinds)

no_building_polygons_top.what_is_lost: every building footprint at the max zoom (house numbers stay); below it buildings stay

small_buildings_top.what_is_lost: building footprints smaller than 1 px2 at the max zoom (z14: about 52 m2 at 41 N; sheds, garages) -- no effect on a z14 pack: the profile's merge already drops buildings under 3.125 px2 below z15

no_buildings_below_top.what_is_lost: building footprints at z11-13 (the style draws the buildings layer at every zoom it has data for)

small_landuse_top.what_is_lost: landuse polygons smaller than 4 px2 at the max zoom (z14: about 210 m2)

no_paths.what_is_lost: footways, cycleways, tracks and steps at every zoom

landuse_undrawn.what_is_lost: landuse kinds the day and night styles do not draw (farmland, residential, commercial, retail, pitch, wetland, meadow, ...), at every zoom

footways.what_is_lost: footways, sidewalks, crossings, steps, cycleways, bridleways, corridors and generic paths at every zoom (tracks and pedestrian streets stay)

small_wood_top.what_is_lost: wood/forest polygons smaller than 16 px2 at the max zoom (z14: about 830 m2)

simplify_landuse_top.what_is_lost: landuse polygon detail at the max zoom: simplified with 0.5 px tolerance (z14: about 3.6 m at 41 N) instead of Planetiler's 0.0625 px

simplify_landuse_all.what_is_lost: landuse polygon detail at z11-max: simplified with 0.5 px tolerance at every zoom from 11

simplify_water_lines_top.what_is_lost: stream and river line detail at the max zoom: 0.5 px tolerance
